title: A repo just for transcripts, addressable, because muSrs is already big (2026-11-05)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
This is just Lisa and I. We have our consent

So, we now have our local mcp server able to serve multiple repos. 
What is the current status of our addressability issues? 
If we are able to manage a repo just for transcripts - and it's addressable it would probably be better. MuSrs is already big
